status_reason: All automatable M12 work and checks passed on post-review code: the note workspace at schema v8 (immutable parent-linked revisions with origin/trigger tags — typed autosave vs explicit snapshot vs dictated/transform arrivals vs restore; AC01's dirty-marker tail-risk banner; AC02's copy-forward restore with editor rebind), managed image attachments (0700/0600 private storage, insert-failure unlink, deletion purge), pinning + escaped local search, the Scratchpad Hub view (VIEWS 8→9 through the M09 triple, tab strip, versions popup, transform picker), dictation into the note as an INTERNAL destination (PTT-time note+anchor binding, insertion_confirmed/scratchpad_note, the external M08 queue never involved — a closed/changed note routes to saved_not_inserted, never a paste elsewhere), note-scope transforms through the M11 engine with whole-note REPLACE semantics and changed-region revalidation (AC-half + regression pinned), the preview panel's Save-to-Scratchpad live (task identity recorded), History copy/move (delete-everywhere on job move; legacy degrades honestly), Markdown/plain export through the document_nodes renderer with unsupported-element reporting and failed-export retention (AC03), and the S29.8 note evidence family (content-free envelope observations behind consent, note_evidence_links closed on deletion, repeated revisions never mint examples or duplicate counts, typed never labeled dictated — AC05; AC04 offline pinned with sockets disabled). Suites: notes store 7/7, editor 4/4, export 4/4, evidence 5/5, scratchpad hub 10/10 through the real coordinator, plus all 39 earlier fast suites, all six model-backed checks and the V1 control (51/51) re-ran green post-review. Benchmark: warm 10,000-word note open p95 0.094 s (budget 0.2); editor acknowledgment during save+search max 1.2 ms (budget 50 ms); autosave flush p95 0.34 ms; 200-note search p95 0.18 ms. The /review-2 → /address loop completed: 4 criticals (all in the AppKit binding the headless tests bypassed — the Transform… button path was broken three ways: NSRange attribute misuse, wrong arity with no picker, and whole-note accept inserting instead of replacing; restore never rebound the editor) and every warning fixed (stale list after create, tab-close editor binding, the false AC01 marker on a no-change flush, the unenforced PTT note binding — now anchored to the hotkey-down capture, the history text fallback chain, the revision_count column misalignment, the unbounded versions list); suggestions applied (shared envelope-append helpers, fail-fast closed-store submits, dead schema cut, partial-export cleanup, pending-attribution restore, attachment-orphan unlink, slugged export names, transform_note task kind, decorators); the review's stale-callback hang was diagnosed to the test harness (a deferred refresh against a closed store — now dropped at close) and closed with regression tests. Pending is the native Scratchpad trial — dictate a note with a list and an image, transform a selection and the whole note, quit/reopen with the tail-risk banner, restore an earlier version, copy/move a History row, and export Markdown from Terminal.app — it does not gate M13's automatable work; 14 human checks are open overall.
